title: Abraham's Grill Hut: TT$175 Restaurant Week seafood package
summary: A seafood-focused Restaurant Week package for one is TT$175 including taxes at this Cunupia spot, extended through October 11.
description: Abraham's Grill Hut's official Trinidad & Tobago Restaurant Week menu lists a TT$175 Flavour Affair package. Its Seafood Affair serves one; the organizer says taxes are included. Restaurant Week's current extension notice keeps the Cunupia offer available through October 11, 2026. The menu page does not list the seafood dish or its ingredients in text, so check the menu image and ask the restaurant about dairy in sauces, sides and preparation before ordering.
